statement:
For every finite union-closed family of sets, other than the family containing only the empty set,
there exists an element that belongs to at least half of the sets in the family.
formal_statement:
union_closed
    [Nonempty n]
    (h_ne_singleton_empty : A ≠ {∅})
    (h_union_closed : IsUnionClosed A) :
    ∃ i : n, (1 / 2 : ℚ) * #A ≤ #{x ∈ A | i ∈ x}
variant_signature:
theorem union_closed.variants.univ_card_two (A : Finset (Finset (Fin 2)))
    (h_ne_singleton_empty : A ≠ {∅})
    (h_union_closed : IsUnionClosed A) :
    ∃ i, (1 / 2 : ℚ) * #A ≤ #{x ∈ A | i ∈ x}
hypotheses: Ground set exactly Fin 2, all four subsets and16 families.
Exclude exactly singleton family {empty}; retain empty family.
Closure is binary set union for every ordered member pair.
quantifiers: For every qualifying family A, there exists i in {0,1} with2*frequency(i,A)>=|A|.
